messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Delayed payments and real-time updates",
 "problem_statement": "Suppliers and policyholders experience delayed payments and status updates due to slow webhook retries and approval processes. These delays disrupt real-time claim processing and cause financial friction for downstream partners.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-22T16:09:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:19:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-17T16:58:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that slow webhook retries in Keelwater's supplier payments module delay payments and real-time status updates. All three quotes (sales 2026-10-22, support 2026-10-28, sales 2026-10-17) consistently describe the same in-product webhook retry behavior causing payment and update delays. This is a product performance issue a squad could act on, not pricing, contracts, customer IT, or a help-article answer, and it is not praise.","verdict":"pass"}
